note: One thing that led to a death: when it happened, what sort of thing it was, and what did it. What follows the opening is settled by the sort.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of thing it was. A server sends 48; what any other sort carries is undetermined.

fields.note: What the thing was about. Its shape is settled by the sort, and is undetermined.
